$Comment: Percent faster block breaking, in whole percent points (10 is +10%), on blocks in the Soft_Wood block family (Server/ZiggfreedCommon/BlockFamilies/Soft_Wood.json, or a block whose own item Tags name Soft_Wood under ZigBlockFamily). ziggfreed-common's gather step adds it to GatherSpeed on such a block, holds the sum at GatherSpeedMax and multiplies the hit's damage by it; the tool still decides what it can break. Any item's StatModifiers raise it like any stat, and so does an effect's RawStatModifiers. Base 0; Min is a generous negative so a subtractive modifier never clamps.
